resources.string: Be somewhere else, five minutes at a time.
Tip: paste a pair like “41.8902, 12.4922” into either field.
Android only lets the app picked as “mock location app” move the device position. Open Developer options and select Altrove.
No Developer options on your phone? Turn them on first: tap “Build number” seven times in

Two optional permissions make it better. Notifications show the countdown. Location access lets Google Play services hold your spot steadily in apps like Google Maps: Altrove itself never reads your real position.
Optional: allow notifications to see the countdown and stop a session from anywhere.

At %1$s. Your real position comes back on its own.
